state.context: The CLI specification calls for Bun.stdin input bounded by a caller int, immutable byte results, fatal UTF-8 conversion for text, and the errors io::limit_exceeded(int limit) / io::read_failed(str operation). No upper bound or behavior for negative max_bytes is written. Integers in Can are unbounded, whereas platform arrays cannot grow indefinitely. Compatibility shims and alternative runtimes are excluded. Chunk retention must stay within the requested ceiling; bigint accounting must precede conversion, and overflowing reads require cancellation with cleanup observation. Environment access uses the caller snapshot, permits only [A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]* names, returns optional absence or required http::credentials_missing, and treats the empty string as an existing entry. Bearer authentication has its separate empty-value rejection. Assertion fixtures must not touch host input.

policy.instructions: Select the implementation strategy most faithful to these input constraints without adding an unstated ceiling.

criteria.bounded: A negative budget yields limit_exceeded, zero is valid, and any positive bigint budget is accepted. Incremental reads enforce the budget; unexpected native allocation faults keep the standard failure channel.
criteria.cap: All budgets above 64 MiB are rejected as limit_exceeded under a new fixed upper threshold.
criteria.eager: Collect the complete stdin buffer through the host before testing its size against the requested allowance.
